* '''Original''' (this page): a post by Kevin Brownell (“CubsFan”), the Committee's Marketing & Player Relations Advocate, in the Committee's forum thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (“official rulings and errata issued by the Rules Committee”), 17 April 2006 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20060617231905/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=4438 Internet Archive capture of 17 June 2006]), headed “Han's Toolkit (v)”: “This card is being errata'd as follows (change in italics):” “Deploy on Han or Falcon. While Han piloting Falcon at a battleground, non-[A] Effects (except ''Presence of the Force'', Emperor’s Power and Search And Destroy) are suspended.” “[A]” is the post's typed immunity icon (immune to Alter); the italics (shown here as in the post) mark “Presence of the Force” as the change. The post gives the text only (no slip image). This is the earliest surviving text of the card: the original Virtual Set 11 sheet (“VirtualSet11GoldEdition.pdf”, 2006) is not preserved, so the text before this errata is unknown.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Han's Toolkit (V) (Virtual Set 11) (Errata)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; the surviving copy is the re-edit headed “Errata to card #8 and #27 on June 25, 2007”; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154617/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards11.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007]), page 2, slip 06, in the Committee's Remaster template: “Deploy on ''Falcon'' or Han. While Han piloting ''Falcon'' at a battleground, non-[Immune to Alter] Effects (except Emperor’s Power, Presence Of The Force, and Search And Destroy) are suspended.” (icons written out in words here.) '''What changed''' (from the 17 April 2006 forum text): “Deploy on Han or Falcon” became “Deploy on ''Falcon'' or Han”, ''Falcon'' is in italics, the exceptions are reordered (“Emperor’s Power, Presence Of The Force, and Search And Destroy”, with “Of” capitalised and a serial comma). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.

== Source text ==
The errata was published as a forum post, not as a slip, so there is no slip image. The post, as captured:
<div style="border:1px solid #a2a9b1;background:#f8f9fa;padding:0.6em 1em;max-width:42em;margin:0.5em 0">
'''Han's Toolkit (v)'''

This card is being errata'd as follows (change in italics):

Deploy on Han or Falcon. While Han piloting Falcon at a battleground, non-[A] Effects (except ''Presence of the Force'', Emperor’s Power and Search And Destroy) are suspended.

— Kevin "CubsFan" Brownell, Marketing & Player Relations Advocate; Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata”, posted Mon Apr 17, 2006 3:32 pm ([https://web.archive.org/web/20060617231905/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=4438 Internet Archive capture of 17 June 2006])
</div>
